answer_1.quote: To test whether models rely more on memorized knowledge or on the current image, we use two types of prompts: 'What color are most <objects>?' and 'What color is this <object>?' for the color task, and similarly for size.
answer_1.outputs: short text answers (color names and size relations)

answer_2.quote: All models perform well on 'this' prompts, achieving over 80% accuracy even when the input image presents a counterfactual.
